reviews.comment: Useless lecture and difficult exams. Not worth taking what's supposed to be an easy class with this professor.

Less than 10 ppl pull up to class. His lectures are not good and boring. I had an 88.5 in the class and he offered no extra credit. He curved every exam but the final. I just needed a couple points for an A and I came to every class. He said no. Found out later that midterm 1 and 2 are on course hero word for word. Do what u want with that info.

Attendance was not mandatory, but all lecture materials and notes were available online. The homework can be challenging, especially if you have no experience with coding or R, but prepares you well for the exams. You aren't allowed to actually use R during exams so you need a really good understanding of the syntax and output, but it's doable.

Prof. Wong in STAT 404 is very nice and tries to be helpful. But his execution of the course is poor at best. This class is intended for students with no coding experience, and although I have 3 yrs of coding, this class was not good. The lectures do not help you on the homework or the exams. Cannot use R while taking test. Do not recommend.
